# Update last-move/copy preferences only after user-action completion

moveOrCopyMessages awaits all operation promises before updating mail.last_msg_movecopy_target_uri and mail.last_msg_movecopy_was_move, and does so only for isUserAction. The delete path does not set those preferences. Preserve this caller-level ordering if changing the UI repeat-operation target. Promise.all is not proof of rollback when some operations succeed before another fails. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: extension message user actions.
